$comment: Materials compared on a tooth in Show patient: 'Choose your cap' (docs/plans/present-studio-design.md sections 8.4 and 11.2, slice 2c). Keys are seeded vocabulary.json material ids. `look` only drives the illustration (paint is a material look in the art kit; translucency and opacity are low, medium or high). `outcome` is a key into outcomes.json; none means no usual figure is shown. `cost_tier` 1 to 4 is a relative guide a clinic may edit, never a price. `strength` and `best_for` stay empty: they show only if the clinic fills them, labelled 'Your clinic's guidance'. English only; reviewed by: pending (founder).

crown.title: Choose your cap
crown.intro: A cap (crown) can be made from different materials. These are the usual ones.

materials.label: Metal and porcelain
materials.summary: A thin metal shell with porcelain baked over it.
materials.looks_like: Tooth-coloured. A thin dark line can show at the gum edge over the years.

materials.label: Zirconia
materials.summary: A solid white ceramic cap with no metal.
materials.looks_like: Even white and solid. Less see-through than natural enamel.

materials.label: Layered zirconia
materials.summary: A zirconia core with a thin layer of porcelain shaped on top.
materials.looks_like: Closer to natural enamel, with a see-through edge.

materials.label: e.max glass ceramic
materials.summary: A glass ceramic that lets light through like natural enamel.

implant_crown.title: Choose your cap on the implant
implant_crown.intro: The cap that sits on an implant can be made from different materials too.

materials.label: Metal and porcelain
materials.summary: A thin metal shell with porcelain baked over it.
materials.looks_like: Tooth-coloured. A thin dark line can show at the gum edge over the years.

materials.label: Zirconia
materials.summary: A solid white ceramic cap with no metal.
materials.looks_like: Even white and solid. Less see-through than natural enamel.

materials.label: e.max glass ceramic
materials.summary: A glass ceramic that lets light through like natural enamel.

filling.title: Choose your filling
filling.intro: A filling can be made from different materials. These are the usual ones.

materials.label: Tooth-coloured filling
materials.summary: A tooth-coloured resin, set with a blue light.
materials.looks_like: Matches the tooth, so it is hard to see.

materials.label: Glass ionomer filling
materials.summary: A tooth-coloured filling that releases a little fluoride.
materials.looks_like: Tooth-coloured, slightly more chalky than the tooth-coloured resin.
